root_cause: index.html loads deferred showdown.js before optionalModules.js and app.js. During deferred script execution document.readyState may be interactive. initializeOnlinePlayerEntry() marks __cmsOnlinePlayerEntryBootstrap=true and schedules start() via setTimeout(0). That timer may run before loadRuntimeScript and reportApplicationError are defined. ensureOnlinePlayerIdentitySurface() throws Online runtime loader unavailable; its catch invokes the still-absent optional reporter, silently losing the error. The bootstrap is marked complete and has no retry, so onlinePlayerIdentity.js never installs. Its capture-phase identity gate, identity badge and remembered-pair initialization are absent.
root_cause_status: confirmed by targeted startup probe; official-run cause inferred from matching symptoms, not instrumented during those three runs

diagnostic.method: A separate Chromium startup probe delays only the optionalModules.js response by 500 ms, observes the original identity timer without changing its scheduling, then taps NEW SHOWDOWN. No source file or official journey was changed. This probe is not a fourth journey run.
diagnostic.result: Timer observes both loader and reporter undefined. After startup both are functions, identity remains absent, bootstrap flag stays true, and NEW SHOWDOWN bypasses sign-in to createShowdown.

deduplication: Additional independent three-run evidence for the existing startup-race report; not an independent new underlying defect.
